Hmm yes, i'm a bit confused now.. I added an alert box to show it:
https://codesandbox.io/s/920j6qw65r
The alert is fired before the console (while console is first) But this shows that the rendering is not completed since you still see the old data, although the DOM does seem the be changed already. So i would also expect a function that would show the alert box after the rendering is finished for some cases.
Just came across this and sounds like it could contribute for some cases where you would want to do something after rendering.
